# Web access

The commands `mt help` lists under Web access. More in [Web tools](../../../concepts/web-tools.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`web-access-get`](#web-access-get) | Show the default knowledge base for web downloads, the tenant's or a namespace's with `--namespace` (where runs keep the web pages their agents read) |
| [`web-access-set`](#web-access-set) | Set or clear the default knowledge base for web downloads, the tenant's or a namespace's with `--namespace` (tenant admins only) |

## web-access-get

Show the default knowledge base for web downloads, the tenant's or a namespace's with `--namespace` (where runs keep the web pages their agents read).

```text
mt web-access-get [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | A namespace, by name, whose default to show instead of the tenant's |

## web-access-set

Set or clear the default knowledge base for web downloads, the tenant's or a namespace's with `--namespace` (tenant admins only).

```text
mt web-access-set <partition> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<partition>` | text | yes |  | A temporary knowledge base, by id or name, or none to clear the default |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | A namespace, by name, whose default to set instead of the tenant's |
